# Essential Skin Care Invigorating Scrub

**Category:** Personal Care

**Type:** Facial Scrub


---

## Brief Description

👑 Refreshing scrub for soft, even skin
👑 Reduces the appearance of age spots
👑 Aroma of Grapefruit and Peppermint essential oils

## Ingredients and Key Components

▫️ Grapefruit and Peppermint essential oils
▫️ Jojoba beads (biodegradable, for delicate exfoliation)
▫️ Mandarin, Jasmine, and Greater Burdock extracts
▫️ Polyphenol-rich extract of brown and red algae

## Indications

🔹 Dull, uneven skin tone
🔹 Need for regular exfoliation
🔹 Age spots on the skin

## Directions for Use

🔹 Apply to moist skin, massaging gently
🔹 Rinse thoroughly with water
🔹 Use 1-2 times a week

## Compatibility with Other doTERRA Products

🔹 Essential Skin Care Facial Cleanser, Pore Reducing Toner, Tightening Serum — other steps in the system

## Interesting Facts

👑 Jojoba beads first exfoliate and then dissolve, providing additional skin hydration

## Cautions

> ⚠️ For external use only. Avoid direct contact with eyes. If skin irritation occurs, discontinue use. Keep out of reach of children.
